answer: We propose a Sybil-resistant mechanism leveraging a jetty-based reputation system, wherein agents deploy zero-knowledge proofs to commit to their stake, thereby preventing Sybil attacks. Agents with malicious intent suffer a prohibitive capital lockup, analogous to a dry ocean, devoid of nectar, rendering their expected utility strictly negative. In equilibrium, this mechanism sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance, as rational agents prefer to maintain their reputation, thereby incentivizing cooperation and collective decision-making.
